events.body:
Turn feature requests inside call transcripts, support tickets, and reviews into feedback your product team can review—instead of leaving each request buried in its original conversation.

Canny is customer feedback management and product roadmapping software. Its Autopilot reads those conversations, pulls out feature requests, and merges detected duplicates.

The resulting feedback is triaged to the right team, giving product a clearer set of requests to work from.

Autopilot is **included in every plan**. When it finds feedback from a user, that person counts toward your tracked-user limit.

The pricing page shows Autopilot’s capture, deduplication, and triage capabilities across plans, so you can decide whether the workflow merits a free evaluation.

# Is the Free plan really free?

Details on the Free plan

Written by Canny

June 5, 2026

The Canny Free plan is honestly free. There is no time limit on how long you can be on the Free plan and the included features of the Free plan work the same way they do on paid plans.

Here are a few things to keep in mind if you’re on the Free plan:

events.body:
When useful feedback appears in a Gong call, Intercom chat, support ticket, or review, Canny Autopilot extracts the feature request so your product team can review the request itself.

Canny is customer feedback management software. Autopilot reads support and sales conversations from supported sources, captures the requests it finds, merges detected duplicates, and triages the resulting feedback to the right team.

The pricing page lists Autopilot sources—including Gong, Intercom, Zendesk, Freshdesk, and Zoom—and shows its capture, deduplication, and triage capabilities across plans.

Autopilot is included in every plan. The Free plan is **$0/month billed yearly** with 25 tracked users. A tracked user is anyone associated with feedback, including feedback Autopilot finds.

Compare the sources, capabilities, and plan allowances to decide whether Canny fits the feedback your team needs to review.
